The original Bank Guarantee is required to be sent directly by the Bank under Speed Post or Registered Post to finance dept. (GM (Fin.), NALCO Captive Power Plant) OR the addressee given in the tender docum ent. The Bidder shall submit copy of Bank Guarantee duly self-certified mentioning dispatch reference of th e Bank from where original Bank Guarantee has been sent. The EMD shall be returned to all unsuccessful bidders after finalization of the order. The EMD of the suc cessful bidder will be returned after they accept the order, submit Contract cum Performance Bank Guaran tee (CPBG) and bank confirmation of the CPBG thereafter. In case, if the successful bidder accepts the orde r but fails to submit the Contract cum Performance Bank Guarantee, the EMD will be retained. In such case s the differential amount towards CPBG and EMD may be deducted from the bills of vendor which may be r eleased after receipt of CPBG. In the event of non-execution of order, the EMD shall stand forfeited.

18) CONTRACT CUM PERFORMANCE BANK GUARANTEE (CPBG): To cover the guarantee liabilities, the seller shall furnish a Contract cum Performance Bank Guarantee (CP BG) in NALCO’s prescribed attached format towards successful execution of the contract and performance guarantee obligation of the equipment/ system as agreed upon from any bank approved by NALCO for 5% of total order value (excluding taxes) including amendment if any. The BG shall remain valid up to 60 (sixt y) days beyond the warranty/ guarantee period. If the vendor fails to submit CPBG after placement of orde r, the equivalent amount will be recovered from the bill(s) of the vendor till the full amount is recovered. T he CPBG shall be sent within 15 days from the date of PO/LOI released by NALCO. The Bank guarantee issu ed the issuing Bank on behalf of supplier in favor of NALCO shall be in paper form as well as under Structur ed Financial Messaging System (SFMS). Original Bank guarantee issued by the issuing Bank shall be sent b y the issuing Bank to NALCO by registered post. You will confirm Bank guarantee confirmation through SF MS in your quotation as per our CPBG format enclosed. Subject to any deduction which NALCO is authorized to make CPBG shall be released after satisfactory exe cution of the contract. On the breach of the contract by the supplier, CPBG shall be forfeited/ encashed wh ether or not the company has suffered a loss on this account and Purchase Order shall be rescinded. Forfei ture/ encashment of CPBG does not prejudice NALCO's rights to make risk purchase and recover damages on account of such risk purchases. CPBG in NALCO’s prescribed format and bank list approved by NALCO are attached under “Additional scop e of work” of this bid. 19) PRE-QUALIFYING CRITERIA (PQC): (ALL THE DOCUMENTS REQUIRED AS PER PRE-QUALIFYING CRITERIA (PQC) SHALL BE SUBMITTE D ALONG WITH THE OFFER. IN CASE OF NON SUBMISSION OF ANY OF THE DOCUMENT, THE OF FER SHALL BE LIABLE FOR REJECTION WITHOUT ANY CLARIFICATION). A. TECHNICAL CRITERIA: Eligibility Criteria: 1. The bidder should have experience of having successfully completed "Similar Order" during the last seve n years ending last day of the month previous to the one in which the tender is floated “Similar Order” means The bidder should have supplied the Ash handling system to any Coal based therm al power plants of capacity 120 MW or higher in which Scrapper chain conveyor system of minimum 17 TP H capacity, is a part and it should have been in successful operation after erection and commissioning for at least two years on the date of bid opening. OR The bidder should have manufactured & supplied Bottom ash system to any Coal based thermal power pla nt of capacity 120 MW or higher in which Scrapper chain conveyor system of minimum 17 TPH capacity, is a part and it should have been in successful operation after erection and commissioning for at least two ye ars on the date of bid opening. OR The bidder should have manufactured & supplied 1 set of Scrapper chain conveyor system of minimum 17 TPH capacity for any coal base thermal power plant of capacity 120 MW or higher and it should have been in successful operation after erection and commissioning for at least two years on the date of bid opening. Note: a) The bidder may either be the OEM (Original equipment manufacturer) of ash handling equipment or Aut horized agency of OEM. b) The Technical & Financial details shall be considered only for the bidder who has participated in the Ten der. Relevant documents to be submitted along with Bid: The bidder has to submit copy of the following documents in support of experience eligibility criteria: 1.

a) In case of OEM Certificate “as a manufacturer of Ash Handling Equipment/Scrapper Chain Conveyor System with detailed address of the manufacturing unit” must be certified by a Cost accountant/ Chartered Account/ Chartered Engineer in practice. OR The certificate issued on the letter head of the Cost accountant/ Chartered accountant / Chartered Enginee r in practice as per the proforma attached at Annex-I b) In case of bidding by Authorized agency of OEM, i) Bid Specific Authorization letter of OEM for bidding of their product against this NIT including the OEM m anufacturing capability certificate. ii) Certificate / Undertaking / Agreement from OEM for back to back support for completion of the Project, Guarantee / Warrantee, Supply of Spares and after sales service. 2. Copies of Purchase Order & corresponding Amendments, Scope of work along with the Invoices. 3. Copies of completion certificate/Performance Certificate of the referred order, issued by the end user or principal owner of the project indicating Order/Contract reference & value and the date of commissioning i n the Letterhead. Note: a) All documents shall be certified by practicing chartered engineer or practicing Cost Accountant/ Charter ed Accountant. b) The completion/Performance Certificate submitted by the bidder shall be considered only when they be ar the Name, Designation & Contact Reference of the Authority issuing them. This is only applicable for the Certificates issued after 30/06/2022. B. FINANCIAL CRITERIA: Eligibility Criteria: 1) Average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three financial years ending with 31st Ma rch of previous Financial Year should be at least ₹ 67.73 Lakhs (Rupees Sixty seven Lakh seventy three th ousand only). 2. Net worth of the bidder during the last financial year shall be positive as per audited balance sheet. Note: (If the end of the financial year of the bidder is beyond 3 months before the Bid Due Date, then it sho uld be the latest financial year otherwise it will be the previous financial year (one year before the latest fi nancial year). In case an audited balance sheet is not available for the latest financial year the bidder shall submit the financial statement for the same duly certified by a Chartered Accountant.). Relevant documents to be submitted along with Bid: 1) The bidders have to submit the copies of audited financial statements and profit & loss accounts of the r elevant years duly certified either by the statutory auditor or an independent practicing Chartered Account ant, in original in support of both the qualifying criteria of turnover and net worth along with the bid. 2) In cases of Group of Companies, where the bidding company does not have their standalone financial, t he bidder shall provide their standalone financial statement duly certified by independent practicing Chart ered Accountant. 3) In cases where the bidding company has consolidated financial accounts, then the standalone financial accounts appearing in the consolidated financial accounts shall be considered. If the consolidated financial accounts do not have standalone financial accounts in it, then the bidder shall provide their standalone fin ancial statement duly certified by an independent practicing Chartered Accountant 4) However, in case it is not mandatory for a company to prepare audited Annual report as per the law of t he country, then the financial credentials certified by the Chief Financial Officer (CFO)/ Chief Executive Offi cer (CEO) of the company, duly endorsed by independent practicing Chartered Accountant in original shall be considered for evaluation of the financial criteria.

NOTE: Certificate issued by a Chartered accountant /Cost accountant must contain a valid UDIN Number. (I n the absence of the same, concerned document will not be considered as a valid document and will not b e used for bid evaluation). .
